result.statement: Every one of the 19,426 2027 positions matches the official 招考简章 workbook cell for cell across all 27 original fields, including workbook sheet and row.

limitations: This verifies the national workbook published on the exam portal on 2026-10-18 against the committed mirror-derived shards. It does not verify later amendments or corrections.
It does not produce applicant eligibility, and it does not verify the major catalogs.
Department-specific attachments verified in earlier rounds remain separate evidence; this national workbook supersedes their coverage for the fields it contains.

supersedes.note: The 805-position figure covered three department attachments only. The official national workbook covers all 19,426 positions and is recorded separately.
